study type: secondary analysis of a multicenter randomized controlled trial
outcome: cesarean delivery of the second twin
cohort: Individuals with twin pregnancies who underwent a trial of vaginal delivery, totaling 1221 participants.
finding: Prediction models were developed and validated to estimate the individualized risk for overall intrapartum cesarean delivery and cesarean delivery of the second twin in twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: The prediction models identified nulliparity, term birth (>=37 weeks), a noncephalic presentation of the second twin, previous cesarean delivery, and labor induction as the most contributory predictors for intrapartum cesarean delivery.
